register.title: Create your RoboSim account
register.passwordHint: At least {min, number} characters. Avoid common passwords and your email name.
register.dateOfBirthHint: We use it only to protect younger users. Under 13s join through their school.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your account email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses {email}, a reset link is on its way. It works for {minutes, number} minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password was changed and you were signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password.
reset.missingToken: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.done: Your email is verified. Thank you!
verify.failed: This verification link has expired or was already used.

banner.unverified: Please verify {email}: we sent you a link.
banner.consentPending: Your account is waiting for a guardian's consent. Until then some features are limited.

gate.title: Sign in to continue
gate.body: Your cloud projects are saved to your account.

password.title: Password
password.done: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

sessions.title: Where you're signed in
sessions.intro: Revoke a session you don't recognise; that device is signed out on its next request.

devMail.title: Development mailbox
devMail.intro: Messages the API would have emailed. Only available in local development.

passwordRule.common: This password is too common. Choose something less guessable.
passwordRule.contains_email: Don't build your password from your email name.

verify.subject: Verify your RoboSim email
verify.body:
Hi {name},

Please confirm your email address for RoboSim by opening this link:
{link}

The link works for {hours, number} hours. If you didn't create an account, ignore this message.

reset.subject: Reset your RoboSim password
reset.body:
Hi {name},

Someone asked to reset the password of your RoboSim account. To choose a new one, open:
{link}

The link works for {minutes, number} minutes. If it wasn't you, ignore this message; your password stays the same.

changed.subject: Your RoboSim password was changed
changed.body:
Hi {name},

The password of your RoboSim account was just changed and all sessions were signed out. If this wasn't you, reset your password right away.
